data.current_summary: Get price range per GB for a location zone
data.current_description:
Returns min and max price per 1 GB (in EUR) across all operators
in the given location zone. If the optional `gb` parameter is provided,
also returns total min/max cost for the specified data volume.

**Actual URL:** `GET /index.php?route=api/esim/zones/priceRange&location_id=X&token=X`
data.description_suggestion: Retrieves minimum and maximum price per 1 GB (in EUR) across all operators in a specified eSIM location zone.
